summary: Frontend-only signup flow re-enablement testing. All 8 test scenarios PASSED: (1) /login page shows new 'New here? Create an account' text with working link to /signup (old 'Contact your admin for an invite' text is gone); (2) mismatched-password validation error renders under signup-confirm-password-error; (3) short-password (<8 chars) validation error renders under signup-password-error; (4) successful signup with fresh email created auth user, auto-logged in without email confirmation, redirected to /courses, and header showed authenticated state; (5) duplicate-email attempt using freshly-created email surfaced Supabase 'User already registered' error via signup-api-error and did NOT navigate away (422 in network); (6) signup-login-link -> /login navigation works; (7) signup-back-home link navigates to /; (8) regression: existing testagent2026@gmail.com login still works and redirects to /courses (or /dashboard). Note: original spec asked for step-4 duplicate check with info@valuevade.com while authed, but PublicOnlyRoute correctly redirected the authed user away from /signup — covered same duplicate-email guarantee by signing out and retrying with the just-created email, which returned the exact expected Supabase error.
action_items: CLEAN-UP: Delete leftover test auth user (email signuptest1788025245@example.com) and its profiles row from Supabase to avoid clutter. It was created by the successful signup test in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: SignupPage.jsx surfaces raw Supabase error messages (e.g. 'User already registered') directly to end-users. Consider mapping to friendlier copy, but non-blocking.
No client-side rate-limiting or captcha on public /signup endpoint — relies solely on Supabase Auth defaults. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting for abuse risk.
